outcome: Paucity of movement of the left upper limb
Resolution of thrombosis and improved limb perfusion
cohort: A single female infant born at 39 weeks of gestation with a birth weight of 2908 grams to a diabetic mother.
finding: Medical management with low molecular weight heparin and aspirin successfully resolved brachial artery thrombosis following a humerus fracture at birth in a neonate, with normalcy achieved by day 3 of life.
